Architect.summary: Designs a complete plan from goals, audience, constraints, and source material; selects features, defines acceptance checks, and preserves editability.
Architect.use_when: the user needs planning, requirements translation, a design system, or a safe execution route before editing.
Architect.core_checks: Preserve editability; verify object bounds and reading order; inspect rendered slides; test links, media, and animations when relevant; confirm target-platform behavior; and save to a new output unless instructed otherwise.

Builder.summary: Creates and edits deliverables from structured input without flattening editable objects unnecessarily.
Builder.use_when: the user asks to create, insert, transform, or complete presentation content and expects an editable artifact.
Builder.core_checks: Preserve editability; verify object bounds and reading order; inspect rendered slides; test links, media, and animations when relevant; confirm target-platform behavior; and save to a new output unless instructed otherwise.

Formatter.summary: Applies precise, consistent theme-aware formatting, geometry, alignment, spacing, layering, and hierarchy.

Formatter.core_checks: Preserve editability; verify object bounds and reading order; inspect rendered slides; test links, media, and animations when relevant; confirm target-platform behavior; and save to a new output unless instructed otherwise.

Auditor.summary: Inspects for correctness, consistency, accessibility, compatibility, and quality; reports priority-ranked findings with actionable fixes.
Auditor.use_when: the user requests review, scoring, compliance checking, issue finding, comparison, or a pre-delivery inspection.
Auditor.core_checks: Preserve editability; verify object bounds and reading order; inspect rendered slides; test links, media, and animations when relevant; confirm target-platform behavior; and save to a new output unless instructed otherwise.

Repairer.summary: Diagnoses and corrects broken or inconsistent output with reversible, recorded changes.
Repairer.use_when: the presentation is broken, inconsistent, incompatible, inaccessible, corrupted, or visually incorrect.
Repairer.core_checks: Preserve editability; verify object bounds and reading order; inspect rendered slides; test links, media, and animations when relevant; confirm target-platform behavior; and save to a new output unless instructed otherwise.

Automator.summary: Runs repeatable, batch-oriented, data-driven operations with safeguards, dry runs, logs, and rollback-friendly outputs.
Automator.use_when: the operation is repetitive, batch-oriented, data-driven, or must be repeatable with scripts and explicit controls.
Automator.core_checks: Preserve editability; verify object bounds and reading order; inspect rendered slides; test links, media, and animations when relevant; confirm target-platform behavior; and save to a new output unless instructed otherwise.
